data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 has been derived from the balance sheet (sum of 'Claims outstanding' liability and 'Reinsurers' share of technical provisions' asset) giving an approximate gross reserve of GBP 182.992m. The report does not present a clearly labelled GROSS prior-year movement figure in the accessible notes or narrative on the provided pages; no explicit gross prior-year reserve movement sentence could be located. A claims development table (gross) is present but numerical extraction was not possible from the images with sufficient confidence. As a result prior year development is not provided here. Many numeric items below are estimated from scanned pages and flagged in data_quality_notes.
data.data_quality_notes: Values were extracted from low-resolution scanned page images. Opening gross reserves were calculated by summing the 'Claims outstanding' liability figure (2014 column) and the 'Reinsurers' share of technical provisions' asset figure (2014 column) visible on the Balance Sheet (page 12). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line (insurance liabilities column) was clearly readable on the provided images; the Profit & Loss Technical Account contains 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' which is NOT the correct source and was therefore not used. A gross claims development table appears on page 21 but numeric cells could not be reliably read to compute prior year development. Where numbers are estimated or derived (opening reserves, gross premiums) this is noted and confidence scores are reduced accordingly.
